en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph with two people standing or sitting atop a tall rocky outcrop, overlooking a small village nestled below. In the background, there are mountains and a few trees. The top left corner of the image contains the printed text: 'Telve, Trentino.' The scene has an old-fashioned photographic style, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
